title: AI to help make logistics less predictable and vulnerable to adversaries, Transcom commander says
summary: Gen. Randall Reed called AI an “engineered vulnerability” in the hands of foes who may use it to manipulate algorithms and lead military logisticians into making “catastrophic decisions based on hallucinated intelligence.” The post AI to help make logistics less predictable and vulnerable to adversaries, Transcom commander says appeared first on DefenseScoop .
